newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices lose ahead of festivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices lose ahead of festivals.

text.p: Indian sugar prices suffered losses on Friday ahead of festivals, dealers said.
"Consumer demand remained lower than expected despite approaching festivals while on fresh arrivals, stockists remained active sellers," a dealer said.
In the ready delivery sugar S-30 fell by 20/40 rupees to 1,260/1,300 rupees per quintal while M-30 moved down by 30/33 rupees to 1,300/1,380 rupees.
The markets resumed after a two-day closure called by traders protesting higher government levies.
Sugar mill delivery slid by 10 rupees to 1,180/1,200 rupees per quintal.
